notes: The church is north of the basketball court.
The gray court and its roofed stand are one basketball space.
The football field starts at the church's upper corner at [330,241].
The football field and park share [1000,365] and [952,814]; [260,657], [952,814] and [1029,831] form one straight southern boundary beside the sidewalk.
The football boundary steps around the small northeast building.
The small south building is the Puesto de Las Playitas.
Lines are a visual interpretation of the satellite reference, not surveyed geometry.
